ready.feedback_bad: Racquet is too low — keep it up in the ready position.
ready.ideal: Racquet at chest height, knees soft.

unit_turn.feedback_good: Quick shoulder turn without a big swing.
unit_turn.ideal: Small turn, hands stay in front.

takeback.feedback_bad: Too much backswing for a volley — shorten it.
takeback.ideal: Racquet face presented early, almost no backswing.

racquet_drop.feedback_good: Racquet head stays above the wrist.
racquet_drop.feedback_bad: Racquet head is dropping — keep it above the wrist.
racquet_drop.ideal: Firm wrist, head above the hand.

acceleration.feedback_good: Punching through with a short path.
acceleration.feedback_bad: Swinging at the volley — punch, don't swing.
acceleration.ideal: Short forward punch with a firm wrist.

contact.feedback_bad: Contact is late — step in and meet it earlier.
contact.ideal: Contact well in front of the body.

extension.feedback_bad: Soft hands collapsing — punch through the ball.
extension.ideal: Arms extend toward the target briefly.

finish.feedback_good: Compact finish ready for the next ball.
finish.feedback_bad: Long finish leaving you exposed — recover the ready position.
finish.ideal: Short finish, eyes and feet recovering.
